parsed.explanation: De-facto criminalisation of gender nonconformity and transition itself via indecent-acts/illicit-intercourse provisions (up to five years), explicitly documented and recent-dated; no legal gender recognition, no anti-discrimination protections, LGBTI groups cannot register, and religious rulings bar affirming care — so an outed visitor has no recourse and cannot sustain document-presentation consistency. Armed groups have killed and tortured people for perceived homosexuality/effeminate presentation in territory they control; that violence is dated (2012–2015) and incompletely recorded, but the militias' territorial control and the state's structural hostility suggest the conditions persist. This mirrors the severe-risk profile: organised armed targeting layered over enforced criminalisation, thin rule of law, no documented relief. Rating slightly above 0.15 because documented killings targeted accused homosexual men rather than trans people per se, and no systematic visitor arrests are documented.
